history.origins: Prostoy durak (simple fool) is a Russian shedding game and a simpler relative of Podkidnoy Durak: it has no throwing-in by other players—only the attacker leads one, three, or five cards and the defender beats or picks up. It is now less widely played than Podkidnoy but remains familiar to many who learned it from their parents. The game is also played in Poland as Dureń Piątkowy (five-card fool).

setup.dealing: 5 each. One face-up for trump. Stock on top.

rules.objective: Get rid of all cards. Last with cards = Durak (Fool).
rules.gameplay: 1. Attacker (left of dealer first) plays 1, 3, or 5 cards: single; pair+any; two pairs+any or four+any. 2. Defender beats each with higher same suit or trump. 3. All beaten: discard; defender becomes attacker. Some beaten: unbeaten to defender; attacker = left of defender. None beaten: defender takes all; attacker = left of defender. 4. Draw to 5 until stock empty. 5. Cannot attack with more cards than defender holds. 6. Trump 6 â†” face-up trump. 7. Draw possible if 2 left, equal cards, all beaten.

strategy.basic: Attack with 1 when defender strong. Save trumps.
strategy.intermediate: Attack 5 when defender weak. Count cards.
strategy.advanced: Endgame: cannot lead more than defender.
